NIGHT_THREATS: Numbers triple after dark and they gain darkvision.
At night the parasites take over and they coordinate like a single organism.
Dormant by day; at night they hunt in packs led by a Level +5 alpha.
Sunset triggers a frenzy; they attack anything, including each other.
After dark they go quiet and stalk. You won't hear them.
At night they retreat to nests and the region's real predator comes out (roll a second mob).
They light fires at night. Follow the glow only if you want a fight.
Night doubles their level and halves their loot.
RUIN_FEATURES: A signpost pointing to the nearest settlement. Half the signs lie.
A crashed circus wagon, cages open.
A public restroom that still works. Guarded by nothing. Suspicious.
An abandoned shrine to an Old God; offerings still fresh.
A fog bank that never lifts. Minimap goes dark inside it.
A collapsed bridge; the detour adds hours.
A crawler graveyard with names carved in three scripts.
A working fountain. The water is fine. Probably.
A gallows with a fresh notice: crimes and the crawler executed for them.
Ruined guildhall; the training dummies still animate.
A carnival calliope playing slowly, somewhere in the fog.
A rooftop route that avoids the streets, if you can climb.
